definitions.engine_breakout: previous_season_finish is None or > 13, AND this season positional finish <= 12 (copied from the breakout engine; rank 13 is not a non-starter)
definitions.first_time_elite: not previously_top12 AND this season positional finish <= 12
definitions.prior_rank_source: Phase 1 previous_season_finish (last observed prior season, not a calendar year-1 join)
definitions.prime_window_method: smoothed P(top-12 | integer age, position) >= known-age position baseline and n >= 15; longest consecutive run
definitions.missing_exp: omitted from career-stage cohorts, not labeled rookie
definitions.missing_capital: omitted from draft-capital cohorts, not labeled UDFA
